name: Sand Spit
description: The Pokemon slithers through the desert sand, eating some of it in the process, if it gets hot (or sneezes) a sandstorm will blow up.
effect: Whenever a foe makes Contact with this Pokemon, the User initiates Sandstorm or Duststorm Weather (as if they had used a Move to do so). This ability may activate a number of times equal to half the User's Rank Bonus (rounded up).
